draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.37, the 38th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 6th of 36 at CB. He went 24th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (90th percentile), 10-yard split (87th percentile), vertical jump (96th percentile). College production: 8 passes defended in 2022, 13th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the New York Giants. 45 career games and 35 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 5 in 2023. Weak spots: passer rating allowed 126.7 (3rd percentile), missed tackle rate 13.9% (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 41.3% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, above the norm.
